versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the brainstorming skill with a strict process for exploring and refining user ideas before any implementation work.
- Hard gate: All creative or feature work requires a formal design discussion and user approval before code or planning begins.
- Detailed step-by-step checklist, including project context exploration, clarifying questions, proposing approaches, presenting designs, spec documentation, automated and user-driven reviews, and only then implementation planning.
- Explicit rules for scope management, decomposition of large projects, and handling visual questions with dedicated companion messages.
- Emphasis on modular system design, working within existing codebases, and targeted improvements only as part of new work.
- Only the writing-plans skill may be invoked after completed brainstorming; all direct implementation is prohibited until the process is complete.
